name: Go Go Magnet!
summary: Ready to dive into the sea of excitement, treasure, and epic battles? Cast your magnetic hook into the depths of the sea to fish for gold and all sorts of treasures. Visit vibrant islands, uncover mysteries, and challenge rulers in battles to advance to the next chapter of your journey. Attack other players' ships and steal their gold to become the richest pirate. Personalize your crew with countless unique characters. Join events, embark on side quests, and gather specific items to be the top-notch adventurer of Go Go Magnet! Collect coins, build your fortune, and show off your mastery of the art of fishing and exploration!
